findings.message: qryListarMeusAvisos filters by period (dataInicio, dataFim) but no state holds the filter. Added public states filtroDataInicio and filtroDataFim with setters setFiltroDataInicio and setFiltroDataFim; qryListarMeusAvisos(page, append) reads them.

entry param avisoVencimentoId selects an aviso, but no method selects and no state holds the selected record (qryAvisoPorId.aviso has no state). Added selectAvisoVencimento(id|null), which publishes the id and writes the fetched notice into avisoAtual (the state that feeds avisoDoDia); null restores the most recent notice.
avisoAtual is documented as the most recent notice but also receives the selected notice from qryAvisoPorId, since the defs declare no separate state for it.
public filtroDataFim is not declared by the defs; the shared added it so the pages can drive the page (a draft, a setter, a selection or a filter state).
public filtroDataInicio is not declared by the defs; the shared added it so the pages can drive the page (a draft, a setter, a selection or a filter state).
